source_content: The desk lamp dims after five idle minutes when battery powered. During a software update it stays bright. The default brightness for visitors remains undecided.
target_content: The garden sensor samples each hour while solar power is available. On a rainy day it waits until noon. The winter interval has yet to be agreed.
next_content: The field beacon transmits twice per day while solar power is available. During a storm it keeps a cached signal. The beacon night policy has yet to be agreed.
